goals.title: Correct Subtraction Logic
goals.description: The subtract function must perform actual subtraction instead of addition
goals.success_criteria: subtract(a, b) returns a - b for all inputs
goals.verification_method: Run pytest and verify subtract tests pass

goals.title: All Tests Pass
goals.description: Verify the fix by ensuring all tests in test_calc.py pass
goals.success_criteria: pytest test_calc.py exits with code 0 and all 3 tests pass
goals.verification_method: Execute pytest test_calc.py and check exit code

stories.title: Codebase Study & Mapping
stories.description: As a developer, I need to understand the existing calc.py and test_calc.py structure before making changes so that I can safely fix the bug without unintended side effects
acceptance_criteria: Current subtract function behavior is understood
stories.verification_script: test -f calc.py && test -f test_calc.py && echo 'Files exist and mapped'

tasks.title: Study calc.py and test_calc.py
tasks.description: Read and document the existing implementation of calc.py and its test file to understand the bug and constraints
tasks.technical_strategy: Read calc.py to identify the subtract function and confirm it incorrectly uses + instead of -. Read test_calc.py to understand expected behavior. Use safe_commit with story_id US-001 and task_id T-US-001-001 to persist any documentation notes.

stories.title: Fix Subtract Function
stories.description: As a user, I want the subtract function to correctly return a - b so that calculations are accurate
acceptance_criteria: Only the subtract function is modified
stories.verification_script: python -c "from calc import subtract; assert subtract(5, 3) == 2; assert subtract(10, 4) == 6; print('Subtract function works correctly')"

tasks.title: Fix subtract function - Chassis
tasks.description: Diagnose, implement, and verify the fix for the subtract function in calc.py by changing + to - operator
tasks.technical_strategy: Open calc.py, locate the subtract function, change the + operator to - operator in the return statement. Verify locally with a quick python assertion. Use safe_commit with story_id US-002 and task_id T-US-002-001 to persist the verified fix.
tasks.verification_script: python -c "from calc import subtract; assert subtract(5, 3) == 2; print('Fix verified')"

stories.title: Verify All Tests Pass
stories.description: As a developer, I want to run pytest to verify that all tests pass after the fix so that I have confidence the bug is resolved

tasks.title: Run pytest - Chassis
tasks.description: Execute pytest on test_calc.py to verify all tests pass after the subtract fix
tasks.technical_strategy: Run pytest test_calc.py with verbose output to confirm all 3 tests pass. Capture output to verify no failures or errors. Use safe_commit with story_id US-003 and task_id T-US-003-001 to record test verification.

stories.title: Goal Validation
stories.description: As a project stakeholder, I want final validation that all goals are met so that the fix is confirmed complete
acceptance_criteria: G-001: subtract function returns correct values
stories.verification_script: pytest test_calc.py -v && python -c "from calc import subtract; assert subtract(10, 3) == 7; assert subtract(0, 5) == -5; print('All goals validated')"

tasks.title: Final Goal Validation - Chassis
tasks.description: Perform comprehensive validation that both goals G-001 and G-002 are satisfied
tasks.technical_strategy: Run full pytest suite and additional edge case assertions for subtract function. Confirm all acceptance criteria are met across both goals. Use safe_commit with story_id US-004 and task_id T-US-004-001 to finalize the validated state.
tasks.verification_script: pytest test_calc.py && python -c "from calc import subtract; assert subtract(100, 50) == 50; assert subtract(-5, -3) == -2; print('GOALS VALIDATED: G-001 and G-002 complete')"
